resolvedFindings.issue: Untrusted advertised product names retain Markdown image/link syntax in auto-published latest.md.
resolvedFindings.reproduction: A synthetic product title containing ![tracking](https://example.com/pixel) appears unchanged in the rendered table. No external image request was made by the reviewer.
resolvedFindings.fix: Encode Markdown metacharacters or emit safe literal text; add hostile-title regression fixture.
resolvedFindings.resolution: All punctuation in merchant-controlled table text encoded as numeric entities; only intentional source links remain, validated separately against URL/host policy. Original hostile-title fixture no longer emits Markdown images/links.

resolvedFindings.issue: HTML fallback checks whether the card itself is hidden, but does not check hidden ancestors.
resolvedFindings.reproduction: A product-card nested in a div[hidden] is returned as one advertised offer.
resolvedFindings.fix: Exclude card if any ancestor is hidden/template/script/style/aria-hidden; add hidden-ancestor fixture.
resolvedFindings.resolution: HTML cards and JSON-LD honor hidden/inert ancestors; visible-card and ordinary JSON-LD-in-head positive controls retained.

resolvedFindings.issue: Single-character Chinese numeral match can parse twelve months as two, twenty months as ten; Markdown output also omits count from otherwise correct period objects.
resolvedFindings.reproduction: A three-month synthetic offer is rendered as month without count. Static inspection confirms partial Chinese numeral matching.
resolvedFindings.fix: Parse complete supported Chinese numerals or retain unknown; display period count and unit; add 12/20-month and distinct-duration fixtures.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Complete duration tokens parsed for supported numerals; unsupported or malformed duration remains unknown; Markdown shows positive count plus unit.
